Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud accused the UAE of building unauthorized military bases in Somalia and arming forces outside federal control.
He said the UAE signed port deals for Berbera, Bosaso and Kismayo directly with regional administrations, bypassed Mogadishu, backed regional rivals against the federal government, and played a role in Israel’s December 2025 recognition of Somaliland. 
He also cited a January incident in which the UAE allegedly moved Yemeni separatist leader Aidarous al-Zubaidi through Berbera without federal consent. 
“A brother does not burn your house, does not buy your property without your knowledge, and does not divide your family,” Mohamud said. 
Somalia cancelled all its agreements with the UAE in January, but Puntland, Jubaland and Somaliland say their deals remain valid.
